import subprocess
import json

TICK_TO_LOG = 71
LOG_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/log_actions.py"

actions_to_log = [
    {"type": "storage_read", "target": "shared/agency_lab/docs/README.md", "metadata": {"status": "failed", "reason": "File not found"}},
    {"type": "storage_read", "target": "shared/agency_lab/docs/onboarding_guide.md", "metadata": {"status": "success"}},
    {"type": "submit", "target": "Log Actions for Tick 70", "metadata": {"eval_id": 164}}
]

actions_json_string = json.dumps(actions_to_log)
command = ["python", LOG_SCRIPT_PATH, str(TICK_TO_LOG), actions_json_string]
subprocess.run(command, check=True)
